first_public_date_evidence: Springer publisher listing for the first hardcover of Kozlov, Combinatorial Algebraic Topology: 24 October 2007. The older 2003 Björner–de Longueville publication is bibliographically attested only at year resolution in accessible records, and no artificial day is assigned to it.
scientific_integrity: Original assertion is the multiplicity-free three-Specht rational representation and its all-permutation trace. The sphere-wedge homotopy type and Betti ranks are explicitly attributed to earlier research. No independent audit or external mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only rational homology as a natural symmetric-group module, for ground sets with at least seven elements; no integral lattice, modular, or equivariant homotopy assertion. A published homology-concentration theorem is assumed, not proved anew. The standalone finite checker corroborates but does not establish the infinite theorem.
title: Multiplicity-free rational homology of triple Kneser neighborhood complexes
